category: commercial VPN: the sanctioned egress class for debrid services that whitelist VPN ranges

free_tier.stated: No free plan on the order page; a 31-day money-back guarantee is the only trial-shaped offer: 'All plans are covered by a 31-day money-back guarantee.'

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a tunnel, not an object

egress.terms: Standard plan: $12.95 per month on the monthly term, $2.15 per month on the 2-year term ('Billed $58.20 for 27 months, then auto-renews at $47.95 annually'). The order page states '6,000+ VPN servers' and does not state a bandwidth cap; the plan table sells features, not bytes.

interface_detail: Vendor apps and OpenVPN/WireGuard-style configs depending on platform; the order page sells the subscription, not the protocol list.
tooling: vendor client on desktop and mobile; a VM would run the Linux client or a WireGuard config. The exit address is shared with other customers, which is the point and the risk.
chaining: The sanctioned egress class for Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Mega-Debrid, which refuse servers and proxies but authorize VPN ranges: at $2.15-$12.95 a month for unlimited bytes it is the only egress product that is cheaper than the debrid subscription it carries.

limits.value: the exit address is shared and can change between sessions; each debrid service whitelists or blacklists whole ranges, and a shared exit that someone else abused can be blacklisted

limits_note: A commercial VPN is a server IP, so it fails the same class test as a VPS unless the debrid service has whitelisted the range. The whitelist is by range and by provider, not by customer.
binding_note: what fails is the debrid side's range check, which returns a block for the whole exit regardless of how much was paid.

identity_cost.detail: Checkout with card; the order page says 'Accepting Credit Cards, PayPal, Bitcoin, and other Crypto payments'. No identity document was mentioned on the page read.

reliability_note: Shared exits attract abuse, and one debrid service's range check is answered per address: the same subscription can work from one server and be refused from the next.
confidence_note: The price is documented from the vendor order page read today. The compatibility claim is a 2020 vendor press release, and the vendor's own live list at real-debrid.com/vpn rendered zero cooperative rows today, so the claim is reported and contradicted rather than confirmed.

evidence.proved: Standard plan '$12.95' monthly and '$2.15 per month' on the 2-year term, 'Billed $58.20 for 27 months'; '6,000+ VPN servers'; '31-day money-back guarantee'
vendor press release: 'PureVPN is one of the few "cooperative" VPNs listed on their website', dated 2020-07-28.
the live 'Cooperative VPN providers - Recommended' table contains only its header row, so the claim above cannot be confirmed from the vendor it names

price_per_tb_month: USD 2.15/month (2-year) to USD 12.95/month (monthly), no byte meter published
notes: It is here only as the price of the sanctioned egress class, and the egress topic owns VPN records; if promoted, merge the pricing with that topic's VPN set rather than keeping two homes. The affiliate pages that rank for 'real-debrid vpn' (vpnalert, vpncompare, vpntrends) all assert cooperative status for NordVPN, Surfshark, ExpressVPN and PIA; they are affiliate content and none of them was treated as evidence.

extras.bandwidth: not stated on the order page
